messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"APMO","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"APMO","units":[{"chapter":26,"text":"thy malice and causedst them to be cast out of paradise; and I will put enmity between thee and his seed: he shall bruise thy head and thou shalt bruise his heel until the day of Judgement.\"","source_ref":"26:4"},{"chapter":27,"text":"Thus he spake and bade the angels have us cast out of paradise: and as we were being driven out amid our loud lamentations, your father Adam besought the angels and said: \"Leave me a little (space) that I may entreat the Lord that he have compassion on me and pity me, for I only","source_ref":"27:1"},{"chapter":27,"text":"have sinned.\" And they left off driving him and Adam cried aloud and wept saying: \"Pardon me O Lord, my deed.\" Then the Lord saith to the angels, \"Why have ye ceased from driving Adam from paradise? Why do ye not cast him out? Is it I who have done wrong? Or is my judgement","source_ref":"27:3"},{"chapter":27,"text":"badly judged?\" Then the angels fell down on the ground and worshipped the Lord saying, \"Thou art just, O Lord, and thou judgest righteous judgement.\"","source_ref":"27:5"},{"chapter":28,"text":"But the Lord turned to Adam and said: 'I will not suffer thee henceforward to be in paradise.\"","source_ref":"28:1"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 26:4, 27:1, 27:3, 27:5, 28:1.
